name: Saikoro Psycho
source:
The heroines are all psychopaths!

A visual novel ADV where you fall in love with crazy girls.

Be careful not to be killed by psychopathic heroines when you play!

(Translated from [url=https://enoshima210.work/2020/06/09/sc7/]the official site[/url]).
translation:
女主角都是神经病啊！

一款让你爱上疯狂女孩的视觉小说ADV。

玩的时候要小心不要被心理变态的女主角杀死！

（翻译自[url=https://enoshima210.work/2020/06/09/sc7/]官方网站[/url]）。
